description: The line plot illustrates the average performance (%) of three metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—across increasing model sizes, ranging from 70 million to 7.0 billion parameters. The x-axis, labeled with model sizes (“70m”, “160m”, “410m”, “1.0B”, “1.4B”, “2.8B”, “7.0B”), uses a logarithmic scale and is marked at intervals corresponding to these discrete model sizes. The y-axis, labeled “Avg. Performance (%)”, spans from 0 to 80 in linear increments of 20. The red line with triangle markers represents Precision, which begins near 79% at 70m and gradually declines to approximately 75% at 7.0B. The blue line with triangle markers indicates Recall, starting near 8% at 70m and steadily increasing to about 44% at 7.0B. The purple line with triangle markers denotes the F1-score, beginning at approximately 14% at 70m and rising to around 56% at 7.0B. All three lines exhibit smooth, monotonic trends across the model size axis, with Precision decreasing slightly while Recall and F1-score increase significantly as model scale grows.
